what_happened: Confirmed the dispatch's root-cause hypothesis exactly as stated: reviser-agent is dispatched via two paths (aux_dispatch orchestrator_mode:false, and dispatch[] plan-phase orchestrator_mode:true via resolve_agent()'s artifact-based admission rule), and agents/reviser-agent.md has no handoff-writing section for either path. Chose direction (a): add a planner-agent.md-style conditional handoff section to reviser-agent.md, plus a Handoff Writers table row in handoff-schema.md and a clarifying note in SKILL.md's Skill-to-Agent Mapping table. No script changes needed; existing-plan->reviser-agent dispatch routing is intentional and test-pinned (Group 23 Cases C/E in test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh).

Planning pass found a fourth, already-stale statement about the same Handoff Writers table: scripts/reconcile-task-status.sh:66 claims planner-agent sits in the table's 'Never writes a handoff, by design' row, which is false today. Folded into Phase 3 as a comment-only correction at no extra cost, since the task is already about making the table's statements agree.

lint-agent-contracts.sh Check J is content-gated: it only scans agent files that already mention .orchestrator-handoff.json, so nothing would FAIL if reviser-agent.md later loses the section this task adds. Closing that hole needs a new curated in-scope list plus a fixture suite, so it was declared a Non-Goal and recorded as a follow-on rather than widened into this task.

Phase 2's Verification line specified 'verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 agent-system/extensions/core', which exits 2 (no deploy tree) because TARGET must be the repo root, not an extension subdirectory. Worked around by running the equivalent with TARGET defaulted to repo root; PASS, 0 failures.

Phase 3's SKILL.md clarifying note (required by the plan) pushed skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md over Gate 20's per-file byte ceiling (24693 B vs 24500 B ceiling). Compacted the note from a 1086 B new paragraph to a 197 B inline parenthetical in the existing row's Notes cell, then followed this repo's established dated-ceiling-move convention: bumped agent-system/extensions/core/context/config/orchestrator-context-budget.json's ceiling_bytes for this file from 24500 to 25000 with a dated derivation entry. This file is outside task 378's declared file_scope but the dispatch's own top-level instructions explicitly required Gate 20 to pass before reporting completion given the SKILL.md edit; committed separately via git-commit-scoped.sh rather than the phase's scoped commit.

Phase 3's batch-deferred scoped suite run (28 suites mapped by suite-selection-lib.sh for the two touched files) showed 2 NEW-failing suites: test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh and test-redeploy-checkpoint-promotion.sh. Both concern status-transition/promotion logic entirely unrelated to this task's 2-file comment+doc-note change. Confirmed task 381 (implement_postflight_derived_artifact_staleness, actively running in this same batch) declares file_scope including orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh AND test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh itself, with live uncommitted changes in its own task dir at the time of this run -- attributing these failures to concurrent sibling in-flight work, not this task's own edits. Not independently chased further; attributed and recorded per Observation Duty.

Task 378's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
